sha256-dos-manifest-v1:c0d50603619cdee91.title: Pub Pool
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:c0d50603619cdee91.description:
This pool simulator is set in the Pub. You may direct the white ball by moving the cross cursor on the pool table, adjust the spin by selecting the place, where cue strike the ball (nine places on the ball is available such as center, bottom, right, top left, etc.), and select the power of stroke. All balls should be pocketed in the correct order (ball "8" should be pocketed last) on the table formed the regular hexagon. When rack is completed, the game advances to the next level, setting the balls in more difficult positions on the table. 5 misses are allowed for each level before the finish of the game. Audience of the pub watches the gameflow, says different comments on the player's actions, and takes the beer from the barmaid.

The game is available for 1 or 2 hot-seat players. Each player in 2-players mode use own table with own balls and own game set.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:c0d45f579f7cc6ac2.title: Mordred Manor
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:c0d45f579f7cc6ac2.description:
You are lost, on Hallowe'en Night!

And the only way out of an endless back alley is through a decrepid old house known only to few as Mordred Manor.

Are you prepared, in the course of your adventures, to deal with an insane maestro, a sleepy skeleton, a mad scientist and his strangely familiar creation, and a bizarre chef, who would be delighted to have you for dinner...once you are properly cooked, of course.

Mordred Manor awaits.  Do you dare enter?

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:c068df488bddd2432.title: Black Friday 3
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:c068df488bddd2432.description:
A stock market simulation for 1-4 players, each with a starting investment of $5000 and a straightforward goal: become filthy rich by trading in 10 different securities.  Written originally for the DEC PDP-10, and published in the Jan. 1977 issue of Byte magazine, the game is built around a realistic (non-random) simulation of the stock market, which lasts from 3 to 10 game years.

Each year represents a turn, in which players receive dividends and may buy and sell stocks.  Bull market and bear market periods will influence stock values accordingly; stocks must be surrendered if the company goes bankrupt, and split when their value rises to $150.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:c06a0ba14d4bddb2b.title: Letter Targets
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:c06a0ba14d4bddb2b.description: Letter Targets is a freeware ASCII-style game with gameplay similar to Hangman and Wheel of Fortune. Every puzzle number has the same mechanic: you can either choose a puzzle by typing the number or you can just select play and you will get a random puzzle. The length of the word is shown in dots when you begin your puzzle, and you hit letters on your keyboard to guess and try to solve the word. After typing seven letters that are not in the word, it's game over. The game does not have a high score screen or a difficulty setting.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:c0ddfb97d5080abb6.title: The Original Adventure
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:c0ddfb97d5080abb6.description: This was a port of ADVENT. It was endorsed as the "official version" by Crowther and Woods, in return for a small royalty. Although many versions of Adventure were both sold and freely distributed, and although the game spawned an entire segment of the software industry, we were the only company ever to pay Crowther and Woods anything.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:c0e681c6babc3b6c6.title: CHAMP Centipede
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:c0e681c6babc3b6c6.description:
Champ Centipede is a variant of Atari's Centipede.

One or two players must get rid of all the insects invading a mushroom patch, including Fleas, Spiders, Scorpions and the Centipede. The game includes different difficulty levels, sound effects and a high score table. It is controlled either by the keyboard, joystick or the mouse and has single player, player v player and a two player co-operative mode

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:c0b11638ac5b43a0a.title: Sesame Street Crayon: Letters For You
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:c0b11638ac5b43a0a.description:
This computer coloring book is another part in the Electric Crayon series and it has about 30 pictures featuring Latin letters. Each picture includes the letter in upper-case and lower-case, and items which begins from this letter or include it within (for example, on "Aa" picture Apples lie on the ground, Airplain flies, certain person moves out the garbage can with the cap on his head, etc.) with famous characters from Sesame Street to color.

Pictures could be colored from a palette of 16 colors. A mix button would "mix" the current color with the 15 other colors and give a total of 256 colors. Choosing a color and clicking in the picture do a color fill in the area clicked. The finished, or in progress, coloring was automatically saved to disk. Player may also remove all colors applied previously to start coloring from the very beginning.

Pictures could be printed with or without a monthly calendar, description, or message.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:c05d823460b730b49.title: James Clavell's Shogun (1986)
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:c05d823460b730b49.description: Wait, you say, wasn't this an Infocom title? Actually, this one came out first on the budget publisher Mastertronic's catalog. It's a vastly different game than the Infocom one - you wander around as one of a number of characters trying to build up your rapport with the people, doing battle and working your way up to becoming a shogun. An obscure title that I always loved - and the very odd graphics and gameplay, on a 2D surface where you're always flying everywhere, were so strange, but in the end that made it a memorable game.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:c0ebb37c8f0650bd9.title: Whatever We Decide to Call this Game
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:c0ebb37c8f0650bd9.description: Whatever We Decide to Call this Game is a text adventure game where you play the role of a freshman arriving at Tumbulgum University, on your first day. As the introduction explains, there are three seemingly-simple tasks you must complete by the end of your first day: enroll yourself in classes, get a parking sticker, and find a bathroom. You begin outside the imposing entrance of the university's administration building, but to succeed in your quest you will need to find and explore various other buildings across the campus.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:c09679b7654b51319.title: Major League Manager
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:c09679b7654b51319.description: As the name implies you get to run your own baseball team. You play as a sort of all powerful coach with complete control over your team; you do want to have players who can play well though, you can trade, delete, and create new players at will, and you don't have to worry about labor strikes. You can decide where to put all your players, you can tell them what plays to play. All of this is done with real names of real baseball players and real teams. Graphics are colored ASCII.
tags: Construction and Management Simulation; Sports / Baseball

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:c0787c4d52546c08b.title: Gone Fishing
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:c0787c4d52546c08b.description: Gone Fishing is a fishing simulator. Starting small in a rented boat with a plastic worm, a spinner, or other tackle, you can work your way to tournament status, purchasing not only additional tackle, but also equipment such as depth finders and serious bass boats. The player takes over a character's life, balancing business and fishing. Game elements include examining the weather forecast and deciding where to fist. Regular work needs to be done to provide money for the fishing hobby, or tournaments can be entered for financial support when they are won. Once a fish has been caught, it needs to be managed carefully to reel it in.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:c0f0301492e3045b0.title: Ramses
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:c0f0301492e3045b0.description:
Ramses is a merchant/trading strategy game. It is fairly similar to other games of this type from the time period. You begin by acquiring a ship from a ship dealer who is quite animated and very curious. Overall the presentation of the game is visually impressive and not overly difficult.

The game supports 4 players, which adds a fun element of competition to the game.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:c0e0ae385eb213a32.title: Escape
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:c0e0ae385eb213a32.description: The action takes place in the conditional future. Your hero is a physicist working on a remote orbital space station. Suddenly, the station is attacked by hostile aliens, and the only surviving of all its personnel remains precisely the protagonist of the game. He needs not only to survive and get out of the captured station, but also to be able to find and take out an important computer hard disk, where absolutely valuable information is stored, which, if it falls into the hands of the newcomers, will allow them to capture the Earth …

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:c0c484cda5d5c367b.title: Harley-Davidson: The Road to Sturgis
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:c0c484cda5d5c367b.description:
It's just 10 days away from the great bike drop bash happening at Sturgis South Dakota, and you're miles away!

Ride your Harley through the open countryside to get there in time. You must dodge fallen rocks, automobiles, outrun the police, and rescue a few wayward females with car troubles along the way.

During your adventure, you'll be required to upgrade your motorcycle, join cycling events in local towns, and talk to natives in the local stores.

Once you get to Sturgis, then the real fun begins!

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:c0d8dc7e3307a82f9.title: Ultima III: Exodus
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:c0d8dc7e3307a82f9.description:
The third title in the Ultima series, this was the first game in the series to feature a party of adventurers instead of a single player. It also had large, detailed towns with many people to talk to, and a separate combat engine where your party fought multiple monsters in a turn-based tile-based system.

The story? After the defeat of the evil wizard Mondain and his mistress Minax in the previous two Ultimas, peace has returned to the land of Sorsaria. Times passes and eventually geological disruptions and a resurgence of the monster populace occur, and it is soon learned that Mondain and Minax had conceived a child named "Exodus" before their death. Now that child has become an adult with the power to avenge the death of his parents. Obviously, it falls upon you the hero to find and stop him.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:c086aaf43dac81fad.title: Tron
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:c086aaf43dac81fad.description: Tron is a shareware  for one to four players. As each player drives around the game area they leave drive around the game area leaving a solid trail behind them. The object of the game is to cause other players to crash into one of these trails, one of the moving barriers, or the edge of the game area. The first player to win the required number of rounds wins the game, the default winning score is fifteen but this can be altered. An optional feature of this game is the use of missiles which can punch holes in the trails. There are four kinds of missiles available in the game, which the player picks them up by running into them, however each player can only carry one missile at a time.The game is entirely played via the keyboard and the action keys can be redefined, however a mouse can be used to navigate the game's menus. The game makes limited use of sound, just a 'beep' when a player crashes.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:c0c019981f101a4a9.title: Wings
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:c0c019981f101a4a9.description: A multiplayer shooter that continues the tradition of cave-schmups, a very specific genre originated from the Finnish freeware scene. There is a closed space, there are from two to eight players, there is a choice from many different cool ships and weapons - and the task is to kill all enemies! At first it seems that everything is simple, but then, having touched every type of weapon, you understand that everything is much more complicated. Certain colors in the level pictures are interpreted as certain materials: silver is the landing areas where you can land to change weapons and repair the ship. Brown burns beautifully, red explodes with great power, blue and turquoise turn into water, which very realistically splashes and flows if it is allowed. Optionally, it is possible to turn on the rain in the level settings (and the level will be gradually filled with water, under which the dynamics of the ships change radically) or snow that will change the shape of levels beyond recognition.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:c0443f38757358190.title: Museum Madness
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:c0443f38757358190.description: You are a teenage boy. After connecting to computer museum guide you understand that aliens are in museum, maybe the dinosaurs are waked up. So you take the satchel and run to save the museum from the monsters, who are the computer virus. During your heroic action you must solve puzzles and explore museum, studying the natural history and technology and talking to historical figures.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:c02698e1644e4e9ae.title: Dark Hour
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:c02698e1644e4e9ae.description: A collection of levels for Quake. The add-on contains several independent single-player & multi-players maps. There are windows & DOS installers too.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:c0558b4d589817de1.title: Overlord Maniac Car
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:c0558b4d589817de1.description: A Taiwan racing game where you go to various cities in Taiwan collecting race flags and fruit while avoiding the other drivers who seem to be very upset that you have chosen to drive around their city. There is a selection of 4 different vehicles to drive, with each one having different stats in strength, speed, fuel, and turbo.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:c0c26b29ceaf41591.title: Scooter's Magic Castle
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:c0c26b29ceaf41591.description:
Would you like to have your own castle? With lots of chambers, secrets, puzzles and activities to do? Well, Scooter now owns such a castle, and he's very eager to see what he can find inside! And he can find quite a lot.

Scooter's Magic Castle is an education game where you control Scooter, and by clicking on various items in the Castle you can interact with them, often starting a small mini-game. The activities available around the castle are numerous, ranging from simple memory tests to composing your own melody.

During his travels around the castle's corridors, Scooter is assisted by a helpful owl, who acts as the game's options menu and can also teleport you to any chamber.

sha256-dos-manifest-v1:c033b3a44e08db440.title: Slam City with Scottie Pippen
sha256-dos-manifest-v1:c033b3a44e08db440.description:
Slam City with Scottie Pippen is a Full-Motion-Video basketball game. It uses proprietary technology to allow switching from one scene to another without lag, which allows for smoother interactive video.

Gameplay is relatively simple, using little more than arrow keys, and is very different from any other basketball simulation. Basketball is merely the subject for the game's plot, involving the new-guy, Ace (the player), and a host of other characters, basketball players or just spectators, all with different personalities. It's basically play one-on-one on a warehouse court and climb the "ladders" until you earn enough respect to play against Scottie Pippen.

The game features a total of 13 characters, 5 of which the player has an option to play against, all of which are played by real actors.
